RENAME OBJECT EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING TO DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_BU_20240514; GO


CREATE TABLE [EDS].[DID_PRODUCTGROUPING]
( 
    [BANK_CODE]	varchar(5),
    [SOURCE_CODE]	varchar(3),
    [PRODUCT_GROUP]	varchar(50),
    [PRODUCT_TYPE]	varchar(50),
    [PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION]	varchar(100),
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [char](1)  NULL,
	[isLatest] [char](1)  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([GROUPHOUSEHOLDID]),
	HEAP
)
GO


INSERT INTO [EDS].[DID_PRODUCTGROUPING] (
     [BANK_CODE]
    ,[SOURCE_CODE]
    ,[PRODUCT_GROUP]
    ,[PRODUCT_TYPE]
    ,[PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION]
    ,[SCD_Start_Date]
    ,[SCD_End_Date]
    ,[isActive]
    ,[isLatest]
    ,[BNK_CODE]
    ,[SOURCE_CODE]
    ,[FILE_NAME]
    ,[insert_dttm]
)
SELECT
     [BANK_CODE]
    ,[SOURCE_CODE]
    ,[PRODUCT_GROUP]
    ,[PRODUCT_TYPE]
    ,[PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION]
    ,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8) AS DATE ) SCD_Start_Date
    ,SCD_End_Date
    ,isActive
    ,isLatest
    ,BNK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,insert_dttm
FROM EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_BU_20240514; GO
